title: Canopy Color Scheme
description: canopy-color-scheme/1: a facility color scheme layered on canopy-default. Roles merge per role and per mode; an import value of null deletes an inherited mapping. Colors are canonicalised and import targets resolved when the scheme is flattened, not by this schema.

Alias.description: A reference to another role: '@' followed by a 1-64 character role name.

RoleValue.description: One color for both modes, or a per-mode object whose omitted modes are inherited.

phoebus.description: The Phoebus color this role restyles: on import the role is emitted iff the screen color equals this value.

ImportMap.description: Maps a source color name to a role name, or to a slot object choosing the role per source property; null deletes an inherited mapping.

SlotImport.description: A slot-aware import: 'role' is the default role; every other key is a source property name (e.g. background_color) mapped to the role used for that property.
